reference_kind: Fresh independently operated live WebGL viewer; actual Fly first-type checkbox selected, Child and Normal unselected, Neutral alignment

browser_verification.controls: Actual mouse: Fly first-type checkbox selected; Neutral alignment plus Hero/Dark control proofs; RunPower, SwimFly, age; actual orbit drags plus R reset

angle_note: R reset; actual mouse side+100 faces right, square-back+180 visually checked; opposite-side-100, above dy+75, below dy-65. Mouse orbit is visually assessed, not calibrated degrees.
swim_opposition_note: Leftward Swim influence counters later Fly toward balanced value0; no extra negative Swim-family endpoint is included.
intermediate_blending_limitation: At fixed mature age, paired Run+Fly and Power+Fly visually reach nearly their combined endpoint by approximately50% of each signed axis;50/75/100% look very similar. Single controls vary gradually. Linear/bilinear mod interior and rates are an explicit first pass approximation, not the exact viewer morph logic or timing.
